cues.en: They started talking about circuits that acted in nanoseconds,
cues.zh: 他们开始谈论以纳秒级响应的电路，

cues.en: billionths of a second.
cues.zh: 也就是十亿分之一秒。

cues.en: Oh, I didn't know what a billion was. I don't think most of those men downtown know what a billion is either.
cues.zh: 哎，我连十亿有多大都不知道。我觉得市中心那些有钱有势的人多半也不知道十亿是多少。

cues.en: And
cues.zh: 而且，

cues.en: if you don't know what a billion is, how on earth do you know what a billionth is?
cues.zh: 如果你连十亿都搞不清楚，又怎么可能理解十亿分之一到底有多小？

cues.en: I fussed and fumed.
cues.zh: 我为此抓狂又苦恼。

cues.en: Finally, one morning in total desperation,
cues.zh: 终于，在一个绝望的早晨，

cues.en: I called over to the Engineering Building
cues.zh: 我打电话给工程大楼，

cues.en: and I said, please cut off a nanosecond and send it over to me. And I brought you some today.
cues.zh: 我说：请剪一纳秒送过来给我。我今天也给你们带了一些。

cues.en: Now what I wanted when I asked for a nanosecond was I wanted a piece of wire
cues.zh: 其实我要这一纳秒，是想要一段导线，

cues.en: which would represent the maximum distance that electricity could travel in a billionth of a second.
cues.zh: 用来表示电在十亿分之一秒内能传播的最远距离。

cues.en: And, of course, it wouldn't really be through wire. You'd be out in space, velocity of light.
cues.zh: 当然，实际上并不是通过导线传播，而是在真空中以光速传播。

cues.en: So if you start with a velocity of light and use your friendly computer,
cues.zh: 所以如果你以光速来算，再用上你好用的电脑，

cues.en: you'll discover that a nanosecond is 11.8
cues.zh: 你就会发现一纳秒就是 11.8

cues.en: inches long,
cues.zh: 英寸长，

cues.en: the maximum limiting distance
cues.zh: 这是电在十亿分之一秒内

cues.en: that electricity can travel in a billionth of a second.
cues.zh: 所能传播的极限最大距离。

cues.en: Finally, at the end of about a week, I called back and said, I need something to compare this to. Could I please have a microsecond?
cues.zh: 大约过了一周，我又打电话过去说：我需要个参照物，能不能给我来一段微秒？

cues.en: I've only got one microsecond, so I can't give you each one.
cues.zh: 我只有这么一根微秒，所以没法给你们每人发一段。

cues.en: Here's a microsecond.
cues.zh: 这就是一微秒。

cues.en: Nine eighty four feet.
cues.zh: 984 英尺长。

cues.en: I sometimes think we ought to hang one over every programmer's desk
cues.zh: 我有时觉得，真应该在每个程序员的桌子上方挂一根，

cues.en: or around their neck
cues.zh: 或者套在他们的脖子上，

cues.en: so they know what they're throwing away when they throw away microseconds.
cues.zh: 这样他们在白白浪费微秒的时候，就知道自己到底浪费了多大的东西。

cues.en: Now I hope you'll all get the... Your nanoseconds.
cues.zh: 现在我希望大家都拿到……你们的纳秒。

cues.en: They're absolutely marvelous for explaining to wives and husbands and children and
cues.zh: 它们用来向妻子、丈夫、孩子以及

cues.en: admirals and generals and people like that.
cues.zh: 海军上将、将军之类的人解释，简直太棒了。

cues.en: And admiral wanted to know why it took so damn long to send a message via satellite.
cues.zh: 有位海军上将想知道，为什么通过卫星发条消息要花那么久。

cues.en: And I had to point out that between here and the satellite, there were a very large number of nanoseconds.
cues.zh: 我只好指出，从这里到卫星之间，有非常多的纳秒。

cues.en: You can explain these things. It's really very helpful, so be sure to get your nanoseconds.
cues.zh: 你可以用它们解释这些事情。真的很有帮助，所以一定要拿到你的纳秒。
